about: Who may change which paths in this repository: the Owns column of agents/JOBS.md as globs, with the owners incident.conductor@ gave on 10 November 2026 (23:51 UTC) for the paths JOBS.md did not cover. Checked by tools/policy-check.mjs over the commits about to be pushed. A local check (CI's clone is shallow and the tool lives in the repository it checks): it catches mistakes, it is a setting an agent could skip, not a boundary.
by: incident.librarian@web-summit.dinis (drafted, at incident.conductor@'s ask; the owners are the conductor's decisions)
glob: * matches within one path segment, ** across segments; <role> is the committing agent's own role

rules.owns: the agent may change these paths
rules.shared: a path with more than one writer: the check warns and does not fail
rules.unassigned: paths no agent owns yet: a change warns, until the conductor names an owner

incident.conductor@web-summit.dinis.note: agents/*/status.json: the conductor writes each agent's jobs (agents/README.md). The data folders and incident.dev@'s files are shared only while the conductor copies them across for agents whose sessions cannot push here (tools/sync-from-websummit.sh): the librarian's reading of the commits so far, for the conductor to confirm or remove. The conductor integrates: any other path it touches is 'shared' (a warning, never a pass in silence), so every such change shows in the check's output.
